notes: Every SoundWire Slave is required to expose a 48-bit hard-coded enumeration value composed of SoundWire spec version + UniqueID + MIPI ManufacturerID + PartID + Class. This value is intended to live in factory non-volatile memory (typically OTP / e-fuse / mask-ROM / hard-wired registers), exposed to the Master through 6 SCP_Device0..5 registers that the Master reads via consecutive READ commands during enumeration.

factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.name: 48-bit Slave Enumeration Value
factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.field_breakdown: SoundWire spec version (to handle future revisions, if any) || UniqueID (if there are identical parts on bus — value set by implementation-defined mechanism such as pin-strapping; set by system integrator, not manufacturer) || MIPI ManufacturerID || PartID || Class (not defined in v1.0)
factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.purpose: Slave identity for Master enumeration. Stored as 6 SCP_Device0..SCP_Device5 registers; Master reads via consecutive READ commands; Slave reports 'Attached' at Device 0 until a non-zero Device Number is assigned via WRITE.

factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.name: MIPI ManufacturerID
factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.field_breakdown: Assigned per MIPI Manufacturer ID page (admin.mipi.org). Allocated per company.
factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.purpose: Identifies the Slave manufacturer to the bus Master and to the system integrator's discovery flow.

factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.name: PartID
factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.purpose: Distinguishes different Slave parts from the same manufacturer (e.g. different codec variants).

factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.name: UniqueID
factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.field_breakdown: Set by system integrator via implementation-defined mechanism such as pin-strapping; used when identical parts share the bus to make their enumeration values unique.
factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.purpose: Ensures arbitration succeeds when two or more identical Slaves are on the bus.

factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.name: Class
factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.field_breakdown: Reserved for MIPI Device Class identification. Public webinar notes this field is 'not defined yet' at SoundWire v1.0; class definitions live in separate MIPI Device Class specs.
factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.purpose: Categorizes Slave device class (e.g. microphone, smart amplifier, codec).

factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.name: SoundWire spec version field
factory_burnt_protocol_level_state.field_breakdown: Captures the SoundWire spec revision the Slave was designed against, so Master can handle future revisions if any.

scp_device_register_storage: The 48-bit enumeration value is exposed in SCP_Device0 through SCP_Device5 (6 bytes), read in sequence by the Master via Read commands during enumeration. These registers are read-only at runtime; the underlying values are factory-burnt via OTP / e-fuse / mask-ROM / hard-wired straps per vendor implementation.
fuse_otp_implementation_left_to_device: MIPI SoundWire does not mandate a particular OTP / fuse / mask-ROM technology — vendors may implement the 48-bit enumeration value storage in factory-trim, e-fuse, NVMEM, or hard-wired registers as appropriate for the device process. Pin-strapping is explicitly called out as one acceptable way to set the UniqueID portion at integration time.
